name: editflow-studio
description: A prompt-first media editing workspace for text, image, audio, and video.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
